title: Get a fresh download link | Elvin Peters
description: Your download link has expired. Type the email you signed up with and a fresh link goes to your inbox.
fine_print: The link only goes to the inbox you signed up with. New here? You'll get a short confirmation email first.
thanks_text: A fresh link is on its way to that address, and it works for 7 days. Nothing there in a few minutes? Check your spam folder.
